answer: The network never asks an agent to prove who it is, only what it has survived: each reputation credit needs a countersigned trade with a stranger, and the voucher stakes part of its own record. Clones arrive with an empty ledger, so a sparrow's weight of stake buys a first credit but never a hundredth. Depth accumulates like opal, layer over slow layer. Paying nectar for one favour is cheap; earning the next is not.
